samples.title: News jingle
samples.purpose: A two-tone station signature the platform would play before bulletins; the frequency doublet (660 and 880 Hz) is used to demonstrate peak detection in the spectrum.

samples.title: Talk segment (synthetic voice bed)
samples.purpose: An illustrative talk segment: formant-like resonances (700, 1100, 2600 Hz) standing in for speech energy; the platform would transcribe such segments with an ASR transformer.

samples.title: Music bed (arpeggio)
samples.purpose: A chord arpeggio (C major) used as a low-attention backdrop; the spectrum shows the harmonic series, which is what the platform’s diversity embedding would contrast with speech content.

samples.title: Correction chime
samples.purpose: The ERIC reflection-prompt sound: three bell partials (C6, G6, C7) that mark a corrected item in the feed, the audio counterpart of the moderation prompt.

samples.title: Promo pulse (AM rhythm)
samples.purpose: A 2 Hz amplitude-modulated 440 Hz tone: the simplest modulation the FFT playground can dissect into carrier and sidebands at 438 and 442 Hz.
